what: Backlog item 6: a CPU smoke test that loads the champion serving bundle and scores a fixed set of about 50 public ISIC images (tests/test_champion_smoke.py). It skips, saying why, until both inputs below exist.

bundle_asset.note: the evaluated serving bundle (registry v1, model_gen v2; manifest SHA-256 5734add1790eadd6f2e36d767bd78d6fcf5a791484756ed616edf721e8eedee5) as a tar.gz attached to release v1.0.0 by the owner on 2026-11-18 (65 MB); archive SHA-256 checked before use

images_note: written by scripts/make_smoke_manifest.py in the 'Smoke manifest' workflow (.github/workflows/smoke-manifest.yml), where the ISIC API is reachable; committed 2026-11-11 from that run's log: 50 images of 50 different test-split lesions, licences CC-0 and CC-BY-NC, each with attribution, URL and SHA-256. Images are fetched at test time and never committed.
max_abstain_share_why: the abstain threshold is the 95th percentile of the validation OOD score, so on in-distribution test images about 5% should abstain; 20% leaves room for 50 images and still fails a bundle whose detector is broken
